notes.title: Demo Is Live
notes.content:

notes.title: The Demo is Almost Here - Devlog 6
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Community![/h2][p]
First of all - thank you so much for following Train Station Project and for your patience throughout our development journey.[/p][p]We’re excited to share that the game demo will be available to everyone this [b]Friday, August 15th![/b] 🥳[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3112070/Train_Station_Project_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Why the wait?[/h3][p]The demo has been in the works for quite some time because we wanted to deliver [b]two fully professional language versions[/b] right from the start.
Recording and preparing the dialogues took longer than expected - especially since we were also recording lines for the [b]full version of the game[/b] at the same time! 🎙️
[/p][h3]Major Improvements in the Demo[/h3][p]Here’s what we’ve added and refined for this release:[/p][list][*][p]💾 [b]Save system[/b] - you can now save the game anytime after the intro scene.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Full controller support[/b] - play the entire demo from start to finish on a gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p]🔍 [b]UI scaling[/b] - perfect for portable devices.[/p][/*][*][p]🏃 [b]Run mode toggle[/b] [b]option [/b]- no need to hold Shift all the time.[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 [b]Multi-language support[/b] - currently available in: EN, PL, DE, RU, FR, IT, ES, JA, zh-CN, CS, SK, PT, TR.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]Graphics presets[/b] - quickly configure your visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]🔄 [b]Auto controller detection[/b] - switch between keyboard and gamepad at any time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Music for Streamers & Creators 🎵[/h3][list][*][p]We know many streamers mute in-game music due to copyright concerns - no worries here!
[i]Train Station Project[/i] features an original soundtrack by the amazing [b]Michał Ratkowski[/b], and it’s [b]100% safe to stream[/b] without fear of copyright strikes. No need to turn it off![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Content Highlights[/h3][list][*][p]🗣️ Dialogue system with full [b]lip-sync[/b] for characters.[/p][/*][*][p]👀 NPCs react to your actions.[/p][/*][*][p]🪂 Ragdolls for [b]all[/b] characters.[/p][/*][*][p]🐕 Customers with luggage… and dogs![/p][/*][*][p]🚗 New car models.[/p][/*][*][p]🚓 New NPCs in the demo - [b]drug dealer[/b] & [b]policeman[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]😏 Plenty of unique NPC reactions to player behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]⛓️ [b]Prison location[/b] - you’ll have to work hard (or misbehave) to end up there![/p][/*][*][p]🔍 A few hidden surprises for you to discover. 😉[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What’s Next for the Full Version?[/h3][p]In the past few months, we’ve been creating [b]a lot[/b] of content for the full release.
Our plan is to launch the complete game [b]later this year[/b] - and trust us, it’s not going to be your standard simulator.[/p][p]Alongside everyday station tasks, you’ll encounter completely unexpected events and quests that will take you by surprise.
The credits in the demo include only the voice actors featured in this build - there are [b]many more dialogues and special NPCs[/b] waiting for you in the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you for your support. Your enthusiasm and trust mean the world to us! ❤️[/p][p]See you on the tracks and… on Discord! 🚉💨 [url="https://discord.com/invite/H5wycNq4H7"]https://discord.com/invite/H5wycNq4H7[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Train Station Project Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo - Devlog 5
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Community![/h2]

We’ve got a quick update regarding the upcoming demo of Train Station Project.

Unfortunately, we won’t be able to release the demo in time for the upcoming Steam Next Fest on June 9th. We’ve decided not to rush a version that doesn’t meet our standards. Instead, we’ll be releasing a polished and complete demo in July.

We believe it’s better to deliver one solid experience rather than a series of unfinished iterations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/e7051decb386812f27901f3680f4e88a1579ed57.png[/img]
[h3]🛠️ What’s the Current Progress?[/h3]

The good news? Most of the features we initially announced are already implemented! We've also added many of your suggestions from the playtest surveys and we’re super grateful for all the ideas and feedback you’ve shared.

🔹[b]What’s Already Been Added?[/b]
[list]
[*]Animals
[*]Ragdolls
[*]New car models
[*]New animations
[*]Dialogue system
[*]NPCs now perform various new activities
[*]Full English voiceover (Polish voiceover is still in production)
[*]Reactions to player behavior
[*]Passengers with luggage
[*]Protesters
[*]Policeman
[/list]
Thank you so much for your patience, your understanding, and for continuing to follow the development of our project.

notes.title: Playtest Update – One Week Left to Join!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

A huge thank you to everyone who has joined the playtests for Train Station Project! Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and we’re thrilled to have such an engaged community.

The playtest will remain available for another week, until [b]March 3, 2025[/b], so there’s still time to join and check out the demo if you haven’t already!

🔹 [b]Why isn’t there a save option?[/b]
Many of you have asked about the lack of a save system. The reason is simple: the demo can be completed in about 60 minutes, and we’re still actively modifying the game’s save files. If we had implemented saving, your progress would quickly become incompatible with updates. However, don’t worry – the public demo coming in a few months will include a save system!

🎯 [b]What was the goal of this playtest?[/b]
Our main objective was to gauge your general impressions and gather feedback on the overall feel of the game. Thanks to your input, we’re confident that everything is moving in the right direction. Keep in mind that the playtest contains only 5% of the full content – we have plenty of surprises for the full release!

📢 [b]Playtest Update: Polish Localization of 3D Assets[/b]
We received numerous requests from Polish players asking for in-game 3D objects to feature Polish text. As a result, we released a quick update to translate a significant portion of these assets. If you’re playing in English, don’t worry – everything remains the same and fully understandable!

notes.title: Playtest Available Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Station Managers[/h2]

Thank you for your interest and support for Train Station Project! Your enthusiasm gives us great motivation to continue improving the game.

For this first playtest, the game is available in two languages: [b]English[/b] and [b]Polish[/b]. But don’t worry! In the public demo version, we plan to add support for additional languages so that more players can enjoy the game in their native language.

The main goal of these tests is to refine the core mechanics and overall game flow. You’ll find a link to a survey in the game where you can leave your feedback – every opinion is incredibly valuable to us!

We also want to highlight that Train Station Project is not yet fully optimized. We are continuously improving and tweaking the game, so better optimization will be available in the full version and the demo. No worries – the final game will run at 60 FPS even on low-end PCs.

If your graphics card is equal to or weaker than a [b]GTX 1650[/b], we recommend using the suggested graphical settings (screenshot provided below):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/66e317cf01c8161d84708c4b66a97bc0e37cfb1b.png[/img]

[h3]Want to join the playtests? [/h3]
You can [b]sign up[/b] directly on the Steam store page of our game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2681560/Train_Station_Project/

[h3]Thank You for Your Support![/h3]
Join our community on Discord, where you can share your impressions and stay updated with all the latest news.

notes.title: Playtests Starting This February!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Community![/h2]

Thank you for following the development of Train Station Project! We know you've been eagerly waiting for updates, so we're excited to announce that playtests will begin this month ([b]February[/b])! 🎉 If you want to stay up to date and actively participate in discussions, we warmly invite you to join our Discord!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/H5wycNq4H7]https://discord.com/invite/H5wycNq4H7[/url]

[h3]Playtesting the Demo Version[/h3]
The playtests will focus on content that makes up the demo version of the game. We want to note that many elements are still in development – some assets are placeholders, and the player's voiceover is currently AI-generated, but it will be replaced with a professional voice actor in the full version. Additionally, while we have programmed NPC dialogue interactions, we haven't recorded the lines yet, so this feature will remain disabled for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/73b2ed8c6eaa1e468bddb3421290ad988cb67c1c.gif[/img]

[h3]The Purpose of Playtests[/h3]
The main goal of these tests is to refine the core mechanics and overall game flow. We want to ensure that the gameplay provides a satisfying progression. Our vision is for you to experience a true "zero to hero" journey – starting with basic duties and gradually becoming a real station manager!

[h3]What Have We Been Working On?[/h3]
The demo only includes a small fraction of the features we've been developing over the past months! Here are some of the key updates we've worked on:
[list]
[*][b]Mini-market management[/b] - run a store and maintain its stock.
[*][b]Product sales at checkout[/b] - experience the role of a cashier.
[*][b]Employee management[/b] - recruit, assign tasks, and optimize team performance.
[*][b]Luggage scanning and lost & found control[/b] - ensure that nothing suspicious goes unnoticed.
[*][b]Real estate for employee accommodation[/b] - provide housing for your staff.
[*][b]New locations[/b] - prison and detention center are now part of the game.
[*][b]Expanded train stations[/b] - more rooms and activities have been added!.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/e08ffc5c4cba6e6c2bbc7e42a29945561ca5c0ce.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/471660de58adae9b5d37aaa156de24cd1c5f5a02.gif[/img]

[h2]Thank You for Your Support![/h2]

Once again, we truly appreciate your patience and support. These playtests are a crucial step in fine-tuning the game, and your feedback will be invaluable to us. See you on the tracks and… on Discord! 🚆💨

[url=https://discord.com/invite/H5wycNq4H7]https://discord.com/invite/H5wycNq4H7[/url]

[b]Train Station Project Team[/b]

notes.title: Major Updates & Playtest News
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, fellow conductors and station managers![/h2]

First off, we want to thank you for your continued interest and patience with Train Station Project. It’s been a while since our last update, and we owe you an apology for the radio silence. Rest assured, we’ve been hard at work every single day to make this game the best it can be. If you’re eager for more frequent updates, don’t forget to join our Discord channel, where we regularly share sneak peeks and behind-the-scenes content from the game’s development.

Now, onto the news: we’re planning to launch the [b]Steam Playtests[/b] in [b]early 2025[/b]. We originally planned to release them sooner, but we decided to take some extra time to improve the game’s mechanics. Your experience is important to us, and we want to deliver a polished and engaging adventure right from the start.

[h3]Making Train Station Project More Interactive[/h3]
We’ve been focusing on enhancing interactivity in the game, adding depth and variety to the world around your station. Here’s a sneak peek at what we’re working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/3eccdfcc41b7e59c36cae81b3eb5e334eb0d7919.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Street Performers[/b] 🎸 will appear on the station, adding life and ambiance to the environment.
[*][b]Railway Inspector Gameplay [/b]🚦 is coming! In later stages, players will take on the responsibilities of a railway inspector.
[*][b]Dynamic NPC Behaviors:[/b] The station won’t be free of challenges!
[list]
[*][b]Rioters[/b] may stir up chaos and confront other NPCs.
[*][b]Drug Dealers[/b] will discreetly attempt illegal activities.
[*][b]Vandals[/b] could tag walls with graffiti.
[*][b]Police NPCs[/b] are here to restore order and deal with mischief-makers.
[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/1e8f6a0af4549add0e7fe4aa91fa935d6c7350b7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/975ec18d6be53b6d2d039501403f0ce089943b49.gif[/img]

And yes, the interactivity extends to you. Players can now approach and interact with (or even confront) any NPC. NPCs will also respond dynamically to your actions and tools. For the curious: yes, you can strike the train crew (though this is not the main goal of the game). But actions have consequences, so beware — the station’s police station is fully operational, and players can even find themselves behind bars! 🚔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/9b3b78e45c203fea1c8b28232d2a1d513912a930.gif[/img]

[h3]Building System Improvements[/h3]
We’re also refining the construction mechanics. To make object placement smoother, we’re introducing [b]pivot-distance lines[/b], allowing you to align and space objects with precision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/5fff684814d1cbeda27146eabd5abe36ed949dc4.gif[/img]

In conclusion, thank you for your support and patience.

[i]Stay tuned,
The Train Station Project Team 🚂[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/349302cc3a8dbc6d4b4204f4ece6558159631919.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110453/d3977457129fb82f1ed2e02cad1f5c25d1f3a9b2.gif[/img]

notes.title: First Update & Playtest
notes.content:
[h3]Train Station Project Devlog: First Update & Playtest[/h3]

Welcome to the inaugural developer update for our upcoming game, [b]Train Station Project[/b]. We are incredibly grateful for your interest in our project and are excited to announce that sign-ups for the playtesting phase are now open.

At this stage, we have completed the environment for the main location and implemented all the core mechanics. Our focus in the coming weeks will be on polishing the game to prepare for a public demo release.

As a sneak peek, we’ve included a few concept sketches from our talented concept artist, showcasing the creative process behind the game’s environment. Enjoy!
